verdict.rationale: CIPO is an online IP-office service portal, and such portals could plausibly offer a built-in assistant, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents an AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The "generate a tailored guide" IP-strategy tool is a different feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
